name: self-compact
description: Compaction at task boundaries: the model can ask to compact once its turn ends, and after a turn that looks like a finished task in a full context it is asked whether to. Uses decision-model to spot finished tasks when it is installed.

threshold.title: Nudge threshold
threshold.description: Context fill, in percent, above which the model is asked whether to compact after a finished task

toolFloor.title: Tool floor
toolFloor.description: Context fill, in percent, below which the model's own compact_after_turn call is ignored

nudge.title: Nudge
nudge.description: Ask the model whether to compact after a turn that looks like a finished task

method.title: Compaction method
method.description: native, or handoff / shake when compact-methods is installed

idleSeconds.title: Idle compaction
idleSeconds.description: Compact after this many idle seconds above the threshold; 0 turns it off
